source_category: actual native coupled P-SV simulations, no synthetic illustrative wavefield

claims.wavefields: The existing native solver propagates both in-plane displacement components through the full water/solid Marmousi-II domain.
claims.data: Data AD differentiates the actual residual and processed objective, while propagation remains native.
claims.gradients: The native adjoint returns spatial Vp, Vs and density derivatives on the active solid input grid at the smoothed initial model.
claims.verification: Both objective functions pass non-vacuous multistep tests for every advertised parameter family on the declared full-domain correctness mesh.

integrity.model: full original 78x200 prepared Marmousi-II grid; fixed water; active 67x200 solid grid
integrity.wavefield: every exported actual frame, all element-local 5x5 GLL points, both components; Gouraud color interpolation on explicit GLL subtriangles, no fluid/solid averaging
integrity.gradient: unmodified discrete physical-coordinate derivatives; signed-log display allowed with exact scales reported; no smoothing, illumination correction or fitted scale
integrity.taylor: all supplied epsilons, objectives and directions, including failures in the application record
integrity.uncertainty: deterministic numerical checks, no invented replicates or confidence intervals
